ai_ingestion_policy: Store source URL, date, topic, claim, classification and later-evolution notes for every extracted rule.
Do not reduce the curriculum to a single candle/indicator trigger.
Course material may establish concepts; production automation still requires a machine-testable definition and project review.
Quizzes are valuable for identifying intended concepts but should not override clearer primary explanatory material.
Later official examples may broaden earlier rules; preserve chronology.
